why: A value nests at most 500 levels: an evaluation that builds a deeper one stops with the value-depth error. Each call of the function wraps the value of the call before it in 250 lists, so the value passes the limit while the calls return. Calls of FEEL functions do not use the stack of the host, so the evaluation reaches the limit; the previous release overflowed the stack of Node's main thread inside the nested list literals of 190 calls, and the instance trapped.

error.message: values are nested too deeply (more than 500 levels); evaluation stopped
